text: Bad news. Every motor on Earth just hit full power. For five seconds.
Your blender. Thirty thousand RPM. The lid is gone. So is your ceiling.
Every car floors it. Even the parked ones. The driver is still buying coffee.
Washing machine. Full spin. It walks out the door. Your laundry just left you.
The mall escalator turns into a launch ramp. Everyone lands in the food court.
The office ceiling fan rips loose. It chases your boss. Hell yeah.
Motors back to normal. Everything stops. Everyone's alive. Sticky. But alive.
Your laundry is three blocks away. And your boss finally did cardio.
What should go full power next? Comment it, or I pick something worse.
